title: Sharma Traders' bank balance
body:
On 31 March 2027, the bank column of the cash book of Sharma Traders showed a debit balance of ₹42,000, but the bank passbook showed a different balance on the same date. On comparing the two records, the accountant found:
(i) Cheques of ₹18,000 were issued during March, of which cheques for ₹7,000 were presented for payment before 31 March.
(ii) Cheques of ₹15,000 were deposited during March, of which cheques for ₹9,000 were credited by the bank before 31 March.
(iii) The bank collected a dividend of ₹1,500 on behalf of the firm and credited it to the account.
(iv) The bank debited ₹250 as incidental charges.
(v) A cheque of ₹2,000 received from a debtor, which had been deposited and credited earlier, was dishonoured on 30 March and debited by the bank.
The firm had not recorded items (iii), (iv) and (v) in its cash book.
